actual: On unchanged main, test_execute_session_returns_explicit_timeout consistently takes about 6.06 seconds because its global Popen test double also intercepts subprocess.run(taskkill ...) and replaces the termination command with a second sleeper.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
description: The Windows timeout regression test replaces the shared subprocess.Popen symbol for every command. That replacement unintentionally captures the production taskkill subprocess too, prevents the real termination path from running, and reports a false Nightly timeout overrun.
evidence_uris: canonical main a9941381 repeated reproduction on 2026-08-27
expected: The test double must replace only the Nightly child process while preserving the real Windows taskkill subprocess, so the test validates the production timeout contract instead of disabling it.
non_goals: Do not start, stop, or restart any user backend without explicit per-target approval.
title: Nightly timeout test intercepts taskkill and reports a false process overrun
